gaps: P0: nothing. P2: only the Merian/Zeiller fortification plans (#7, #8), which are nearly empty outlines with no buildings drawn.
notes: P1: #6 is the Nîmes view alone from the B&H vol. 1 plate shared with Rouen and Bordeaux (#1 is the full plate, usable as a fallback trimmed to about [0.1, 0.485, 0.505, 0.83]). P3: #9 is dated only ‘between 1800 and 1850’ by the Rijksmuseum; the label shows that range. P4: maker for #15 is not in the record; its sibling print #13 carries the ‘P.Z.’ (Photoglob Zürich) mark. #11 and #13 are stronger single-building shots of the arena if a landmark close-up is preferred. #19 was taken on the day of President Doumergue’s visit (flags visible) but shows only the arena and street, so it is not marked as an event.
